Replies start automatically after you finish. Tap Interrupt and speak to take a turn. You can minimize or switch apps; use the notification to return or hang up. Recording pauses during playback.
Wait for the current reply to finish before calling

Call active · Tap to open the app, or hang up to end

Native audio sends speech and nearby sounds directly to your current model. It requires an audio-capable model and endpoint with direct audio processing enabled. Transcription calls send recognized text only.
Enable direct audio processing for the current chat model and verify that its model and endpoint support audio input. The toggle alone does not add audio capabilities.
Audio sent, including nearby sounds recorded by the microphone
